paragraphs: A newly discovered peptide just won the MySkinMag Awards because it boosted collagen by 52% in facial wrinkles using just a topical cream, which used to sound impossible...
The award-winning research team have tested 117 active ingredients in the span of 18 months to finally capture clinical-level results in a bottle in the form of a cream, easily absorbed by the skin.

The new formula delivers incredible, long-lasting results that help maintain a youthful appearance for months. Participants experienced firmer, more lifted skin after only 4 weeks of regular use! Furthermore, over 95% of participants noticed more even and radiant complexion.
